sources.title: Whisper-tiny-sk | SLAIH
sources.snippet: Slovak fine-tune of Whisper-tiny. This model is intended for Slovak automatic speech recognition across a range of domains and recording conditions. Full parameter fine-tuning on a curated Slovak speech corpus. The corpus combines public datasets with internal KInIT recordings. Recordings containing personal data were anonymised prior to use.
